notes: εἰ μή is split rather than treated as one noncompositional unit because the ASV writes two separate English words, if and not, in different places; rule 39's cluster wants a single English word for the pair.
unto at t019 is kept with ἐπεκέκλητο under rule 106's accusative arm; giving it to Καίσαρα would treat an accusative as if it had a case for English to realize.
τῷ before Φήστῳ is unrepresented under rule 23, so the case preposition unto stays with the name under rule 21's determinerless clause.
